newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran oil workers seek higher wages.
newsitem.headline: Iran oil workers seek higher wages.

text.p: More than 1,000 Iranian oil workers held a demonstration at the oil ministry Sunday to press for higher wages, witnesses said.
"Dozens of police in riot gear blocked the entrance of the building and some of the protesters went inside to negotiate with officials from the ministry," said one witness.
The official Iranian news agency IRNA, which referred to "tens" of protesters, said the workers were from the Tehran oil refinery, the third biggest in the country.
It did not say whether work at the refinery, which has a capacity of 225,000 barrels a day, had been halted.

IRNA reported that the protesters had reached an agreement with ministry officials and would return to work in the next few hours. The agency did not give details of the demands or the agreement reached.
